## 4. Base rates
- Previews say Madrid have won 8 of their 12 meetings with Roma and are unbeaten in the last 7. [Sportsmole](https://www.sportsmole.co.uk/football/roma/champions-league/preview/roma-vs-real-madrid-prediction-team-news-lineups_606745.html)
- Early 2026-27 form was mixed. One source had 6 wins and 2 losses from 8 league games, while others gave 5-0-1 or 15 points from 6 or 7 games. Madrid are 1-0-0 in the Champions League.
- As a general rule, big-club favourites win away Champions League games against mid-tier sides only about 45-55% of the time. This is my rough heuristic, not something I verified from a source.

- Madrid play Barcelona on 2026-10-25, which could lead Mourinho to manage players' minutes. [SI](https://www.si.com/soccer/real-madrid-2026-27-la-liga-fixtures-dates-full-schedule)
